Designed for a real local place.

  • Window, door or storefront decal is the default option.
  • An office or reception display can be used when a decal does not fit the location.
  • The QR destination is the exact member public Franklin Navigator profile, not a generic sales page.
  • The membership term is shown so the display never implies permanent status.

Display selection, address collection, shipping/ready state, fulfillment and renewal replacement are not live yet. No physical item is currently promised as shipped or ready.

What “Community Member” does—and does not—mean.

It means the business or organization has an active paid Franklin Navigator community membership once that system is operational. It is not an endorsement, quality judgment, credential decision, ranking or guarantee.

Free factual corrections and ordinary directory placement remain independent of membership.
